title: Am I All Done at Forty-Two
gist_ar: مزاد بأقصى سرعة. أرقام كتير جدًا في وقت قصير، والمهم تفصل السعر عن رقم اللوت.

before_listening.en: An auctioneer at full tilt. A great many numbers in a short time — separate the bids from the lot numbers and the commission.
before_listening.ar: دلّال بيتكلم بأقصى سرعة. أرقام كتير في وقت قصير — افصل المزايدات عن أرقام اللوت والعمولة.

segments.speaker: Auctioneer
segments.text: Lot two-one-four, the pair of famille rose vases, and you'll find the condition note in the addendum sheet, not the printed catalogue. Start me at twenty-eight thousand. Twenty-eight anywhere. Twenty-five then. Twenty-five, thank you, gentleman at the back — twenty-eight, thirty, thirty-two with the lady on the aisle, thirty-five on the telephone, thirty-five. Thirty-eight. Forty. Forty-two, telephone. Am I all done at forty-two? Forty-two thousand, the telephone bidder. ... Forty-five, is that a bid, sir? It is. Forty-five in the room, and the telephone's out. Forty-five thousand, first time, second time — sold, forty-five thousand, and that's paddle one-one-nine.

segments.speaker: Clerk
segments.text: One-one-nine at forty-five. And can I remind the room that buyer's premium on this sale is twenty-six per cent up to and including one hundred thousand, and twenty per cent thereafter, and that the addendum for lot two-one-four discloses a restored foot rim on one of the two.

segments.speaker: Auctioneer
segments.text: Thank you, and that's an important one, so I'll say it again: a restored foot rim, on one of the pair, disclosed in the addendum and not in the printed catalogue. Right. Lot two-one-five, the Qur'an leaf, and there is no reserve on this lot. Where would you like to start? Four thousand. Four, four and a half, five, five and a half — no, thank you, I've got five and a half here — six thousand, six and a half, seven. Seven thousand with the lady in the second row, and I'm going to sell it. Seven-two. Seven-four. Am I done at seven-four? Sold at seven thousand four hundred, paddle four-oh-two. Lot two-one-six is withdrawn. Two-one-six withdrawn at the vendor's instruction. Two-one-seven, the Kashan rug, and I have a commission bid of eleven thousand, so I must start there — eleven, twelve, thirteen with the telephone, fourteen. Fourteen thousand. Fifteen. Am I all done? ... Sold at fifteen thousand to the telephone. That's the last lot in this session and we'll resume at two o'clock with the manuscripts, beginning at lot three-oh-one, and I'd remind buyers that collection is from the Bermondsey store and not from this building.

Because he holds a commission bid at that level
